name: @xo/intelligence
description: The XO Intelligence Orchestrator — the layer between a customer-facing experience (chat) and the AI provider. Understands what the user wants and handles it through ASK -> DECIDE -> DO -> LEARN, grounded only in authorized organizational knowledge, with cited, honest-about-uncertainty answers. Provider-neutral: it talks to @xo/ai-core's ConversationLayer and never to a vendor.
